title: The Ground Takes Notes
concept: Under one Utqiagvik road two kilometer fiber cables recorded temperature and seismic data from September 2021 to June 2024, and a Penn State led team with UAF's Dmitry Nicolsky built a digital twin that puts a neural network inside a heat transfer physics solver to estimate uncertain soil properties and adjust as data arrives. The film gives the fair case against it its own scene, one road in one town, temperature not road failure, a research framework with no reported deployment and no accuracy number in the public summaries, then shows a separate study's risk curve and Xiao's ten more years. A long violet cable named Strand is the hero and a record ribbon the throughline, ending long-dashed and open on who lays the next cable and who pays.

fingerprint.palette: pale overcast snow light, warm stone and umber strata, bone-white ice, a thin terracotta thaw line, a saturated violet fiber cable hero with a white pulse, pewter instruments, a black-and-white newsprint separate-study card and caution yellow tape reserved for the missing number
fingerprint.metaphor: a violet fiber cable with a face that feels the ground, a paper record ribbon that is printed, fed into a solver, narrowed on two needle dials, held against three witnesses, shrunk to a sliver beside a separate study and extended as ten dashed years, and a dial whose window stays empty because no accuracy number is public

palette: pale overcast snow light, warm stone and umber strata, bone-white ice, a thin terracotta thaw line, a saturated violet fiber cable hero with a white pulse, pewter instruments, a black-and-white newsprint separate-study card and caution yellow tape reserved for the missing number
divergence_note: Recorded palettes. 11-06 tangerine office walls, teal desks, mint hero, magenta ink. 11-02 midnight indigo cab, sodium amber, teal stream, magenta stamps. 11-01 moss green slope, storm slate, sulphur key, lantern gold. 10-31 sage and cream chart desk, cobalt sea, graphite pencil, brass, vermilion. 10-29 aubergine dusk, rose violet snow, ember orange. 10-24 orbital navy, ember amber, ice cyan, peat. 10-17 deep navy cutaway in frost noon. The 06-26 film on this same permafrost story: ice indigo cutaway, ochre active layer, coral thaw front. This film is a pale overcast section in warm stone and umber with bone-white ice and a cool white paper, a saturated violet cable hero, pewter instruments, a black and white newsprint separate-study card and caution yellow on one strip of tape. It breaks all three legs of 10-31's cobalt, graphite and cream, and shares no hue family with any other film above. The one deliberate overlap is a thin terracotta thaw line and drop, a minimal-area callback to the 06-26 coral thaw front on the same story, kept to a few pixels of line. There is no ghost landscape and no dotted twin: 'the model adjusts' is two needle arcs narrowing as ribbon segments feed the solver, where 06-26 and 11-01 redrew a ghost. Its signature object is a record ribbon that is printed above ground, fed into a solver, held against three witness instruments, shown as a stub beside a slab, shrunk to a sliver on a century axis and extended as ten long-dashed years.

treatment.title: The Ground Takes Notes
treatment.summary: All four pitches independently chose a buried fiber cable with a face, Strand, as hero and a Test scene of tags against the twin. The Dramatist's structure won (Record Ribbon throughline, loop A paid by an empty accuracy plate at the Test, loop B paid by Xiao's ten more years). Grafts: the Explainer's kilometer ruler with one lit tenth in the cold open and its calipers 100 METERS, the Comedian's three referees as inspection stickers, and the closing question asking who lays the next cable and who pays. The Comedian's ice cube was cut as decorative, with no data behind it. Doom borrowing rejected, the separate study is a black and white newsprint card, labelled. Revised after the Gate 0 critics: no ghost landscape (the ribbon feeds a solver and two needle arcs narrow), loop B plants a blank question-mark tag, the Test is staged as pictures, 'who pays' gets a blank work order.

angle.thesis: A neural network inside a physics solver, fed by buried fiber under one Utqiagvik road, learns the hidden soil as data arrives, and the work now isn't the algorithm, it's the years of record and the fiber in the ground before the steep part of the thaw curve arrives.
angle.falsifiable_by: A public accuracy number or second site showing the twin drifting from borehole and field checks (c12, c13, c22, c26), or a sourced deployment (c24).
supporting_facts: c7+c8+c9 physics carries what's known, network estimates the uncertain soil
c2+c3+c4 two 1 km cables, Sept 2021 to June 2024, 100 meters
c11 as new data arrives the twin adjusts
angle.counterpoint_scene: THE TEST: one road, one town, 100 meters, no public accuracy number, predicts temperature not failure, not deployed (c22 to c26); drawn at full strength, the model survives as a method and narrows as a tool.
angle.second_movement: c25 ten more years of data vs the SEPARATE study's risk curve (c18 to c20): low until mid-century, steep in the 2090s, so the record has to start now. c21 dollar range from a 2025 study.
angle.cross_challenge: Enthusiast was challenged for treating qualitative validation as proof (kept, but the Test scene names it). Dramatist's 'race' turn adopted; its borrowed doom rejected, the risk numbers are labelled separate. Builder's ask ('who lays the next fiber and who pays for the decade of data') adopted as the button question.
runner_ups: pure skeptic: one road is not a coast (lost: wins no honest ground the Test scene doesn't already take)
pure upside: AI predicts permafrost (lost: false, the twin predicts temperature on one stretch)
guardrails: led by Penn State, never lead author
risk % and $ are SEPARATE studies, high emissions only
public summaries report no accuracy number, never 'the paper'
